rows.grounds: compound denoting the protective armor of the goddess Mātaṅgī; object of gṛhāṇa from previous verse
compound describing the efficacy of the armor as producing all siddhis
indicates the beneficiaries of the armor's efficacy

items.question: What is the nature and efficacy of the Mātaṅgī armor for human practitioners?
premises: The armor is associated with Mātaṅgī.
The armor is divine in nature.
The armor causes all accomplishments for humans.
items.inference: The Mātaṅgī armor is a divine protective means that grants all accomplishments to humans.
items.plain_english: Take the divine armor of Mātaṅgī, which brings all accomplishments to human beings.
